summary_en: The caller initially asked about 100 normal visiting cards with a ₹500 budget, then changed the request to 200 matte-finish visiting cards with a ₹900 budget. The agent explained that 200 matte cards would cost ₹700, fit within the budget, and could be delivered in Vijayawada within 3 working days after design approval. The caller asked for confirmation of the details and then asked about online payment. The agent stated that phone-based online or credit-card processing was unavailable, and that orders below ₹1,000 could use cash on delivery, while orders above ₹1,000 required a 50% advance. The caller repeated the 200-card, ₹900-budget, ₹700-total understanding, acknowledged the payment information, and ended the call with thanks. No order placement or payment was confirmed.
